dialogues.speaker: Inscription Behind the Stone Structure
dialogues.text: To the great runner, Wanjiru.

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (A weathered old stone tablet. The inscription is nearly illegible, but a faint name can still be seen at the bottom.)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (A weathered old stone tablet. The inscription is nearly illegible, but a faint name can still be seen at the bottom.)

dialogues.speaker: Wind-Worn Booklet
dialogues.text: (A badly-damaged, wind-worn booklet, with only a few words still legible...)

dialogues.speaker: Wind-Worn Booklet
dialogues.text: ...seal the borders, contain the Mare Jivari... not a task for just one generation...

dialogues.speaker: Wind-Worn Booklet
dialogues.text: ...my time runs short... put my thoughts in the Sacred Flame... remember, you who follow... — Cochanina

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (A weathered old stone tablet, most of its inscription is worn away...)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...Bakunawa's revival...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...before the return... must block the Mare Jivari... hold back the Black Tide...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...if I fail and fall... let those who come after... — Gloharry

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (A weathered old stone tablet, most of its inscription is worn away...)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...Kiongozi has been gone for over a decade...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...great victory...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...built this shrine... honor the fallen...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (A weathered old stone tablet. The inscription is nearly illegible, but a faint name can still be seen at the bottom.)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: (A weathered old stone tablet, most of its inscription is worn away...)

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...I cloak the Enigmatic Land, and shroud this palace...

dialogues.speaker: Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: ...only the legacy of heroes may awaken... — Shulevitz

dialogues.speaker: Elegantly-Written Booklet
dialogues.text: (A more recent booklet, containing just a few more elegant and joyful words...)

dialogues.speaker: Elegantly-Written Booklet
dialogues.text: Task complete. Now I sing! — Isaja

dialogues.speaker: Inscription Behind the Stone Structure
dialogues.text: To the Border Master, Sanhaj Kompore. His remains are buried here.

dialogues.speaker: Inscription Behind the Stone Structure
dialogues.text: To the brave Menilek.

dialogues.speaker: Inscription Behind the Stone Structure
dialogues.text: To the young Burkina.

dialogues.speaker: Inscription Behind the Stone Structure
dialogues.text: To the chief of the mines, Sundjatta.

dialogues.speaker: Inscription Behind the Stone Structure
dialogues.text: To the giant, Tupac.

dialogues.speaker: Inscription Behind the Stone Structure
dialogues.text: To the everlasting Tenoch. His remains are buried here.

dialogues.speaker: Etchings on the Ancient Shield
dialogues.text: ...In the distance... The faint outline of structures...

dialogues.speaker: Etchings on the Ancient Shield
dialogues.text: ...Familiar shapes... from... or maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Etchings on the Ancient Shield
dialogues.text: ...Impossible... to... investigate...

dialogues.speaker: Etchings on the Ancient Shield
dialogues.text: ...Remember... all that happened...
